_documentation.scale_note: EBV values here are in NSIP-native scale (egg counts for FEC, lb for weights). The pipeline uses them as anchor inputs but does not auto-rescale to flock-internal PR units. Treat anchored-animal rankings as a separate confidence band.
_documentation.convention: For WFEC and PFEC: MORE NEGATIVE = MORE PARASITE RESISTANT. The pipeline inverts the sign internally for PR (so anchored positive PR = more resistant).
